artworks.title: Border Illustration for the Missale Romanum: The Tree of Jesse
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate rectangular frame featuring various figures. The frame is intricately decorated with detailed images of figures in dynamic poses, intertwining with floral and vine motifs. Each side of the frame consists of figures in flowing garments, some holding musical instruments or engaging in conversation. The composition creates a sense of movement and storytelling around the central blank space. The detailed shading and line work suggest a high level of craftsmanship, emphasizing the depth and texture of the figures and leaves.

artworks.title: Border Illustration with the Tree of Jesse
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 17th Century
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: The image shows a decorative border with classical figures. The border surrounds a central rectangular space. Detailed illustrations of figures in classical attire are depicted around the border, with a variety of seated and reclining poses. Some figures hold objects like musical instruments or tools. The figures are shown wearing flowing robes and exhibiting expressive gestures, suggestive of classical or Renaissance influences. The ornamented border likely served as an embellishment for manuscript pages or documents, enhancing their visual appeal with its elaborate artistry.

artworks.title: Border Illustration with Putti Harvesting Offerings to God
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 17th Century
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of an ornate frame with detailed illustrations. The frame is decorated with various symbolic elements, including cherubs, agricultural motifs, and religious symbols. 

The top portion features two cherubs facing a central chalice with a radiant symbol above it, flanked by items that resemble bread and wine. The sides of the frame include designs of sheaves of wheat tied together and what appear to be grapevines. At the bottom, there are cherubs engaged in agricultural activities, such as one holding a sickle and others tending to sheaves of wheat or attending a basin. The overall composition suggests a celebration of agriculture and spirituality through its rich iconography.

artworks.title: Border Illustration with the Ascension of Christ, Keys and Fish
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 17th Century
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate frame with angelic figures and symbolic imagery. The central feature is an undecorated rectangular space surrounded by an elaborate border. Flanking this space are two winged figures, one on each side, each holding a vertical staff topped respectively with a ship and a cross-keys symbol. Above them, two cherubs are leaning into the frame from clouds, amidst rays of light. At the bottom of the image, the scene transitions into a pastoral landscape with vegetation.

artworks.title: Border Illustration with Scenes from the Life of Christ and Putti Pouring Wine
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 17th Century
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate, illustrated border with empty central space. The drawing features an intricate border around a blank rectangular center, designed to resemble an elaborate frame. The border displays classical decorative elements including cherubic figures, swirling vines, and urns. This composition is richly detailed, with small figures and motifs. Within the vertical sides of the border, there are illustrative scenes set within oval cartouches, while the top is crowned with a star-like emblem flanked by smoky urns. The bottom features a row of vessels with two cherubs interacting with them.

artworks.title: Border Illustration with Heaven and Hell "Corpora S.S."
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 17th Century
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental frame. The center is blank while the surrounding artwork is intricate. At the top, there is a bird with outstretched wings, decorative patterns, and a winged figure. On the sides, there are classical figures wearing flowing garments. At the bottom, human figures are arranged horizontally, with one appearing to rest a head on hand. The word "CORPORA" is written in a decorative cartouche at the base of the frame.

artworks.title: Border Illustration with Two Putti and Fruit
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate decorative frame. The empty rectangular space is encircled by an elaborate border with intricate carvings and reliefs, including floral motifs, swirling patterns, and two cherubic faces at the top corners. These angelic figures are highlighted by wings and ornate scroll-like decorations. The overall composition features detailed textures suggesting a lush use of foliage and decorative elements.

artworks.title: Border Illustration with Two Putti "Scientia, Fortitvdo, Pietas, Timor-DNI, Sapientia, Intellectvs, Consilivm"
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate frame with empty space in the center. The illustration depicts an intricately designed border surrounding an empty central area. The border includes decorative elements such as two small cherub-like figures at the bottom, one holding a cross and the other a shepherd's crook. Above them is a Latin inscription "TIMOR DNI," which translates to "Fear of the Lord." The top portion of the border features an eagle with outspread wings amidst architectural elements reminiscent of columns and pediments. Surrounding the frame are additional Latin words: "SCIENTIA," "FORTITUDO," "PIETAS," "SAPIENTIA," "INTELLECTUS," and "CONSILIUM," which translate to "Knowledge," "Fortitude," "Piety," "Wisdom," "Understanding," and "Counsel" respectively. The style of the drawing suggests influences of classical and baroque art periods, emphasized by the grandeur and detail in the architectural motifs and the allegorical figures.

artworks.title: Border Illustration with Putti Holding the Attributes of the Passion
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper [proof before letters]
artworks.description: The image shows an elaborate decorative border with a blank rectangular space in the center and cherubs surrounding it. The top features draped fabric, a plate, a goblet, and a lamp, while the bottom includes two books, a large candlestick with lit candles on both sides, and a draped cloth. The color palette is grayscale, with varying shades of black and white. Positioned at each corner are cherubs, two on each side of the rectangular space in the center, with symmetrical elements at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Title Page for Anatomia Totivs Avgvstissimae Doctrinae Avgvstinae
artworks.artist: Netherlandish 17th Century after Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving featuring a group of religious figures. A bearded man stands in the center holding a flaming heart and a scroll, while four seated figures surround him. The background includes ornate clouds and a radiance above. Latin text is present at the bottom center of the image.

artworks.title: Title Page for Cornelii Iansenii ... Avgvstinvs
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image features three religious figures, depicted waist up in a triangular composition. The central figure is a bearded man with long hair, wearing a mitre and holding a heart with a flame in his left hand, while pointing upwards with his right. Flanking him are two other bearded men wearing mitres and holding staffs. Both hold texts, with the left figure wearing robes adorned with a cross. The scene includes engravings of flourishes and symbols, with the Latin inscription "CHARITAS DEI" above them in the clouds, illuminated with rays. The engraving is framed by an ornate border and a title plaque at the base contains detailed Latin text about Cornelius Jansen, with elaborate scrollwork and decorative motifs. The background is filled with stylized clouds and radiant light, set on a plain background, suggesting it is part of a book or manuscript.

artworks.title: Title Page for Liutprand, Opera
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle II after Erasmus Quellinus II after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene featuring classical figures and ornate heraldic elements surrounding a central column containing text. The image showcases a detailed composition where a seated female figure is placed atop a grand pedestal with flowing garments, holding a torch and an orb. She is accompanied by various mythological and symbolical figures, such as a muscular man with a cross and a male figure in a robe gesturing upwards. Shields, flowing banners, and floral decorations enrich the scene, while a rectangular base with engravings adds another layer of intricate detail. The setting evokes themes of knowledge, enlightenment, and possibly honor or memory, indicated by the textual inscriptions and decorative motifs representative of classical art styles and scholarly publications.

artworks.title: Title Page for Heribert Rosweyde, 'T Vaders Boeck
artworks.artist: Hans Collaert the Younger after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a book cover or frontispiece featuring classical architectural elements like stone arches and columns. Surrounding a central banner with text are various figures labeled with names such as "ELIAS," "IO BAPTISTA," and "PAVLVS." At the top, two seated figures are positioned on either side of a tablet with text, while below them, other figures are engaged in animated gestures. The central banner offers text with decorative framing. Below the central banner, two additional figures flank a skull. The drawing is executed in a precise, detailed style typical of illustrated manuscripts or engravings from a historical period, characterized by high contrast and intricate line work.

artworks.title: Title Page for Giacomo Bosio, Crux Triumphans et Gloriosa
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a religious scene with symbolic figures. The image features a central figure standing on a pedestal, holding a large cross with flowing robes, surrounded by clouds. There are two seated figures on either side of the pedestal, one holding a book and a chalice, and the other gesturing upwards. The pedestal is ornate and inscribed with text. Above the scene, halos and symbols surround and highlight the figures. The illustration showcases intricate design and detailed shading to capture the grandeur and solemnity of the scene.

artworks.title: Title Page for Hubert Goltzius, Graeciae Vniversae Asiaeq. Minoris et Insularum Nomismata
artworks.artist: Michel Lasne after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate title page from an old book or manuscript. The page features a baroque decorative frame surrounding a central inscription. The top of the frame is adorned with an eagle perched atop a heraldic shield. To the sides, there are various classical elements such as an owl, scrolls, and other symbols. The bottom section of frame displays symmetrically placed mythical winged creatures supporting a coat of arms. The title within the frame is written in Latin. The illustration conveys a sense of historical grandeur and scholarly importance.

artworks.title: Title Page for Ludovicus Nonnius, Commentarius in Huberti Goltzi Graeciam, Insulas, et Asiam Minorem
artworks.artist: Michel Lasne after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate title page. The title page is rich with classical and mythological elements. In the center, there is a detailed cartouche with Latin text. At the top, there is a large eagle, a small owl, spears, and quivers. The cartouche is framed with architectural motifs and surrounded by flourishes, a horn, and floral garland. At the bottom, two griffins flank a crest or emblem. The overall aesthetic suggests a blend of artistry and typographic design, likely indicative of historical and scholarly significance.

artworks.title: Title Plate for SS. Apostolorvm Icones
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate decorative frame containing text. The central focus is an ornate design featuring a shield or plaque encircled by various symbolic elements and decorative motifs. The plaque reads "SS. APOSTOLORVM ICONES A PET. PAVLO RVBENO delineate A. CORNELIO GALLE evulgate ANTVERPIÆ." A cherubic face is depicted at the top of the plaque, surrounded by lush draped fabric, weapons, and various symbols. At the very top, there are religious elements, including a bird, likely a dove, and a cross. The design is monochrome, executed with intricate line work on an off-white background.

artworks.title: Title Page for Maffeo Barbarini, Poemata
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure standing in a dynamic posture on a rough surface. The man has deep-set eyes, a furrowed brow, curly hair, and a muscular physique. He is wearing a draped garment, revealing his arms and legs. In one hand, he holds branches with bees. There are swirling patterns in the background, a tree trunk to the left, and an arched structure with text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Title Page for Maffeo Barbarini, Poemata
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure struggling with an animal. The image shows a strong figure with wild hair exerting power over an animal, likely a lion, as indicated by its mane and muzzle restraint. The scene is set in a rocky environment with a tree branch above and Latin text below, all framed within a classical arch. The composition features vigorous lines and shading that convey movement and power, reminiscent of Baroque art styles.

artworks.title: Title Page for D. De Aedo y Gallert, El...Viaje del Infante Cardenal...
artworks.artist: Ignatius Cornelis Marinus after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate title page for a book commemorating the journey of Infante Cardinal Ferdinand of Austria. The drawing shows an elaborate and symbolic design featuring a central crest adorned with a crown and various heraldic elements, including an eagle spreading its wings. Flanking the crest are two winged cherubs, one on each side. Below the crest, the text reads, "El Memorable y Glorioso Viaje del Infante Cardenal D. Fernando de Austria." On the left, a muscular, bearded figure in classical attire holds a sword, while on the right, a draped female figure holds a palm frond. The drawing is intricately detailed, emphasizing the grandeur and significance of the event being commemorated.

artworks.title: Title Page for Le Voyage Dv Prince Don Fernande Infant d'Espange, Cardinal
artworks.artist: Ignatius Cornelis Marinus after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a book cover for "Le Voyage du Prince Don Fernande Infant D'Espagne, Cardinal." The image shows an ornately detailed coat of arms adorned with regal elements and mythical figures. At the top center, there's a crest crowned with intricate heraldic symbols, supported by scrolls and a pair of cherubs flanking the composition on either side. On the left side, a warrior figure with a helmet and armor holds a staff. On the right, an angelic or divine figure draped in flowing fabrics holds a circular object. The center foreground features text, including the title and publisher information, framed by decorative borders and baroque-like flares.

artworks.title: Title Page for Agostino Mascardi, Silvarium Libri IV
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate title page from a historical book featuring classical figures, heraldic symbols, and inscriptions. The central panel contains Latin text stating "AUGUSTINI MASCARDI SILVARUM LIBRI IV." Flanking the text are two cherubic figures, one playing a lyre and the other blowing into a horn. Above the text is a decorative crest with a laurel-crowned profile, while the sides feature intricate foliage and scrolling elements. The bottom portion includes two stylized faces, one wearing a helmet, with a central motif of a Pegasus or winged horse.

artworks.title: Title Page for Agostino Mascardi, Silvarium Libri IV
artworks.artist: Theodor Galle after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This image shows an intricate title page design. In the center, a block of text in a serif typeface reads "AVGUSTINI MASCARDI SILVARVM LIBRI IV AD ALEXANDRVM PRINCIPEM ESTENSEM S.R.E. CARDINALEM." Flanking the text are two angelic figures. One holds a lyre and the other has a trumpet. Above the text, there is an ornate medallion bordered by laurel leaves with a profile of a classical figure. Below the text, two classical masks are depicted: one with a neutral expression on the left and another possibly comedic expression on the right. This drawing demonstrates the baroque style of historical title pages with intricate detail, classic iconography, and balanced symmetric design elements.

artworks.title: Title Page for M.C. Sarbievski, Lyricorum Libri IV
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a depiction of an ornate, symbolic composition with classical elements. There are two figures on either side of a large central object resembling a lyre or harp. Above the object is an intricate coat of arms topped by a papal tiara and crossed keys. The figures are draped in cloth, with one gesturing towards the central object and the other interacting with a cornucopia. Stylized trees and foliage are in the background. Inscribed text at the base likely serves a dedicatory or explanatory purpose with a decorative border. The overall style appears influenced by the baroque era, focusing on allegorical and classical themes.
